test_title: PYST 51: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following services is jointly controlled by both the Union and State Governments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Administrative Service**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Indian Administrative Service (IAS)** is one of the three All India Services, along with the Indian Police Service (IPS) and Indian Forest Service (IFS).
 
• All India Services such as the IAS are **jointly controlled by the Union and State Governments**. Officers are recruited by the Union Government but work under both Union and State Governments during their careers.
 
• The IAS officers are responsible for **implementing central and state government policies**, advising ministers, and handling day-to-day administrative affairs.
 
• The recruitment for IAS is conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) through the **Civil Services Examination**.
 
• IAS officers are posted in various capacities, such as district collectors, secretaries in state governments, and secretaries in central ministries, ensuring coordination between the Union and State Governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Medical Service**

 
 
• This service is primarily under the control of the **State Governments**. It involves the management and administration of healthcare services within a particular state.
 
• State Medical Service officials are responsible for implementing state-level health programs and overseeing public healthcare facilities.
 
• Unlike All India Services, this service is not jointly controlled by the Union and State Governments.
 
 
 
• **Indian Economic Service**
 
 
• The Indian Economic Service (IES) is a **Group A Central Service** that is fully under the control of the Union Government.
 
• IES officers are recruited by the UPSC to provide economic advice and policy support to various ministries and departments of the Central Government.
 
• Since the IES is a Central Service, it is not jointly managed by both the Union and State Governments.
 
 
 
• **Central Engineering Service**
 
 
• The Central Engineering Service (CES) is a **Group A Central Service** under the Union Government.
 
• It primarily deals with engineering services in various central ministries, such as railways, road transport, and public works.
 
• CES is not an All India Service and does not involve joint control by Union and State Governments.
